verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own dashboard filtering by release, including a "does not equal" operator in the shared Release filter, and status-based filter views. The evidence covers only the release dimension and says nothing of the rest of the story. Missing for 10: cross-project event search, filtering by tag, environment and custom properties, a documented query syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and filter events across projects by tag, release, environment, and custom properties with a real query syntax

citations.quote: filter your dashboard by release and identify which release errors were introduced in.
Adding a "does not equal" operator for release in the shared Release filter
